question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Operating cash flow covers almost none of reported net income: over the trailing four quarters the ratio is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2025 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2024. Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}; the annual accruals cell {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} is the highest filled year against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} the year before, and the first-quarter cell {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} is the highest filled quarter against {trend_table.quarters-back-5.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} a year earlier. The cause is the sale of businesses, not working capital: trailing net income {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income} carries the 10-K's discontinued-operations income for 2025 and the first-quarter result booked with the CCS sale, while the divestiture proceeds land in investing cash flow. Operating cash flow itself worsened, to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.this_year_to_date} for the six months against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.prior_year_to_date}, and to {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} for the derived second quarter against {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.inputs.before}. On working capital, the cash-flow statement shows receivables {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change} and inventory {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.cash_flow_statement_change} absorbing cash, while the balance sheet shows receivables {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} and inventory {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} against a year earlier. The articulation gaps {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap} and {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap} arise because the year-earlier balances were filed while CCS and RUCKUS were inside the company and the cash-flow statement does not segregate discontinued operations. The payables articulation cannot be tested because the payables change is not tagged. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, far above the neutral level: income swings much more than cash, the opposite of smoothing. Every trailing figure adds the as-filed fiscal 2025, with RUCKUS in continuing operations, to recast year-to-date figures. So the free-cash-flow base {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} carries operating cash from businesses now sold, higher cash taxes, and interest paid {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_paid} on debt since repaid to {terms.debt_now}. None of these recurs. No field separates the divested businesses' operating cash, so no cash-flow adjustment is written; adding back the interest alone would overstate the base.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Earnings do not reflect cash. Net income is dominated by divestiture gains and discontinued-operations tax items, and the company used operating cash in the half. The divestitures explain the gap, not a working-capital build, but reported net income says nothing about the cash the remaining business generates.

revenue_recognition.finding: Days sales outstanding rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, and receivables over revenue rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}, while quarterly revenue changed {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year on year on the recast basis. Neither comparison is like for like. The first-quarter cell was filed while RUCKUS was in continuing operations, and the year-ago cell pairs an as-filed receivable with recast revenue; the trailing figure {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding} carries the same mismatch. No text explains the receivable balance. Comcast's share of receivables rose to {concentration.facts.41|pct} from {concentration.facts.36|pct} at the first-quarter end. It stays below Comcast's share of second-quarter sales, {concentration.facts.38|pct}, which does not point to extended terms for the largest customer. Contract liabilities over revenue fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}, but the first-quarter balance included RUCKUS. Against the recast year-end balance behind the annual cell {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}, the current balance {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} is higher, so deferred revenue is growing, not being drawn down into revenue. The release credits the prior-year quarter's stronger result to licence sales that the MD&A never mentions. That quarter's gross margin, {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct} against {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} now, fits a high-margin licence recognised at a point in time, but the filing gives no detail. Amphenol MSA revenue in discontinued operations is negative, and no cause is given. Fourth-quarter revenue concentration cannot be tested: the fourth-quarter cells rest on a different revenue tag, and no fourth-quarter share is computed. No new policy wording, variable-consideration, principal-versus-agent, standalone-selling-price, bill-and-hold or extended-payment-term text is carried, so nothing was found on those points.
revenue_recognition.verdict: No sign that revenue is running ahead of collections or of deferred revenue. The recast dominates the receivable and deferred-revenue movements. Left unexplained are the rise in days sales outstanding and two revenue items: the prior-year licence sales and the negative MSA revenue.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The allowance for doubtful accounts is at its thinnest on record. Its ratio {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} is the lowest filled quarter, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} a year earlier, and the annual ratio {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} is the lowest filled year, against {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} in fiscal 2022. An allowance of {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance} covers receivables of {terms.balances_now.receivables} concentrated in Comcast and Charter. It is estimated under a practical expedient that assumes current conditions persist, and no text explains the thinning. The warranty ratio moved the conservative way, to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio} from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}, the highest filled quarter. No inventory reserve is tagged in any period. Tax carries the quarter. Continuing income is a tax benefit on a pretax loss, and the six-month continuing tax line is a benefit of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.parts.this_year_to_date} on pretax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income.parts.this_year_to_date}. The note names an equity-compensation tax benefit and a deferred-tax remeasurement, neither said to recur. The trailing effective rate, {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}, mixes bases and cannot be used. Second-quarter net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter} rests mostly on a RUCKUS discontinued-operations tax benefit that no paragraph explains. Several other tax items moved without explanation: the first-quarter tax-planning benefit left continuing operations with no text saying where it went, the prior-year valuation allowance dropped out of the recast explanation, and deferred tax assets fell sharply. The expected refund appears only in the release. Three estimate changes raise income: variable incentive compensation expense fell while incentive payments rose, legal expense fell with no matter named, and other income gained on financial assets the notes do not identify. Goodwill is unchanged between the recast year-end and the quarter end, while Aurora operating income fell sharply and gross margin is the lowest filled quarter; no impairment test, headroom, discount-rate or growth assumption is carried. Restructuring charges and the reserve rose under a new plan, but the reserve is tagged to the earlier programme. The OWN/DAS carrying-value adjustment has no stated cause, and the withdrawn RUCKUS cost estimate has no update.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: The quarter's earnings lean on judgment. Continuing income is a discrete tax benefit, net income is mostly a discontinued-operations tax benefit, the bad-debt allowance is at its thinnest, and several expense estimates moved in income's favour. Only the warranty reserve moved the conservative way.

cost_deferral.finding: No capitalized development cost is tagged in any period. Research and development is expensed, and it fell to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.this_year_to_date} for the six months against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date} on lower Aurora spending. That lifts current earnings but moves no cost onto the balance sheet. The soft-asset share {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} is the highest filled quarter, against {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} at the first-quarter end; most of the move is cash leaving through the special distribution, not capitalized cost. Within the soft assets, prepaid expenses and other current assets jumped between the recast year-end and the quarter end, with a large operating outflow on that line in the quarter. The MD&A names the increase but not its contents. The restricted deposits the line once held were returned, so the rise is something else, possibly a tax receivable tied to the expected refund. Items presented as one-off recur. Restructuring charges and transaction, transformation and integration costs appear in every period presented, the programme rolled from CommScope NEXT into a new plan, and further charges are expected. The Core measures were redefined as Aurora alone and exclude corporate costs once allocated to divested businesses. Corporate and other carried an operating loss outside Aurora, and the transition-service income that offset those costs fell sharply. The release's non-GAAP adjusted net income sits close to GAAP continuing income only because the GAAP figure includes the discrete tax benefit, which the reconciliation reverses. No non-GAAP gap is computed, because no tagged field carries the non-GAAP figure. Upfront revolver fees were capitalized as deferred financing costs, which is normal practice and small. Capital expenditure fell to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.this_year_to_date} for the six months, and trailing capital expenditure over depreciation and amortization is {earnings_versus_cash.capital_expenditure_over_depreciation_and_amortization}.
cost_deferral.verdict: No sign that costs are being capitalized to lift earnings. The soft-asset rise is mostly the cash payout, but the prepaid jump is unexplained. Recurring restructuring and transaction costs, together with an Aurora-only Core measure, make the company's preferred profit measures look better than GAAP.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: No proceeds from the sale or factoring of receivables are tagged in any period, and the notes carry no such programme: nothing found. The same holds for supplier finance, where no obligation is tagged and no text is carried. Unconditional purchase obligations and guarantee exposure are not tagged either, and no variable-interest-entity text is carried. Nothing was found there, though the record cannot say whether the company does not tag these items or the quarter's notes omit them. The operating lease liability fell to {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.operating_lease_liability} with the divestitures. On classification, the cash-flow statement does not segregate discontinued operations. Operating cash flow therefore carries the sold businesses' operations, higher cash taxes, and interest paid of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_paid.parts.this_year_to_date} for the six months against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_paid.parts.prior_year_to_date}, while the divestiture proceeds sit in investing; this depresses operating cash flow rather than lifting it. The letter-of-credit deposits were returned in April. The release's three-month column prints a restricted-cash line and an end-of-period total that do not tie as printed, while the six-month column prints none. That is a presentation defect, with no sign that the return ran through operating cash. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} equals {earnings_versus_cash.share_based_compensation_over_operating_cash_flow|pct} of trailing operating cash flow and is already subtracted in {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}. Beyond it, dividend equivalents on unvested awards were recorded against retained earnings at declaration and will be paid in cash as the awards vest. That is a cash cost that never passes through the income statement, and the August distribution adds more. The revolver's borrowing base rests on receivables and inventory, so those balances now govern liquidity.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: Operating cash flow is not lifted by factoring, supplier finance or reclassification; if anything, the sold businesses' taxes and interest depress it. Off-balance-sheet exposures cannot be measured because none is tagged.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: No auditor's report accompanies the 10-Q, and the inputs carry no auditor change, material weakness or critical audit matter. The controls item states that disclosure controls are effective and that internal control did not change. That is in a quarter when Amphenol performs services under a reverse transition agreement, RUCKUS moved to held for sale and the company became a single segment; no prior controls item is available for comparison. A same-day 8-K lists a director-or-officer change item whose body is not in the inputs. A departure of the chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller can therefore be neither confirmed nor ruled out. The 8-K index shows no late-filing notice. Prior-period values changed. For the year-end, the 10-K's cash, receivables, allowance, inventory, prepaid assets, property, goodwill, intangibles, deferred taxes, payables, and accrued and other liabilities are all superseded by different 10-Q values. The totals are unchanged and the held-for-sale lines rose. That is the disclosed RUCKUS recast, not a quiet restatement. But no text bridges the filed first-quarter balances to the recast ones, and the deferred tax liability moved up, a direction the reclassification alone would not produce. The 10-K tags the same common shares outstanding at both year-ends while weighted shares differ, which looks like a tagging carry-forward. The debt table's year-end column carries notes that the MD&A says were repurchased in full in the first half of 2025. Pending-standard disclosures were removed without comment, including one on share-based noncash consideration in revenue contracts. The first-quarter treatment of preferred-share dilution changed with the recast. No related-party growth, subsidiary-list change or SEC comment letter appears in the inputs.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: No direct control failure is visible. The filing does carry several disclosure-quality defects, and one officer-change filing could not be read. The changed prior-period values are a disclosed recast, not a quiet restatement.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The numbers confirm most of the notes items. Among them are the tax benefit on a pretax loss, the RUCKUS sale proceeds, the concentration percentages, the inventory and prepaid build, the deeper operating cash outflow and the lower research spending. They contradict three MD&A statements. The transaction-cost figures in the prose differ from the filing's own reconciliation table. The special distribution is given at a figure that neither the tagged dividend nor either cash-flow presentation carries. And the capital-expenditure decrease is stated at the current six-month level, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.this_year_to_date}, rather than as the fall from {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.prior_year_to_date}. The forward-looking items, the negative MSA revenue, the legal expense and the valuation allowance stay unresolved because no field bears on them. The 8-K release matches the 10-Q on revenue, continuing income, the tax benefit, six-month operating cash use, the distribution paid and diluted shares ({terms.diluted_shares}). It differs from the 10-Q in four places. Basic earnings per share differ, both from discontinued operations and in total. The release's quarterly operating cash use differs slightly from Python's derived quarter, {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}, which implies an unexplained recast of first-quarter cash flow. The release's cash total includes cash held for sale, where the balance sheet prints {terms.balances_now.cash}. And its three-month restricted-cash column does not tie. Several explanations appear only in the release: the licence-sales explanation, the split between legacy and Access Technologies sales, memory-chip pricing as a headwind (the MD&A credits lower input costs), the expected tax refund and the year-end cash outlook. The MD&A still describes the revolver at its old size after the cut.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: The release and the 10-Q agree on the headline figures. But the MD&A carries three figures that the filing's own tables or tagged facts contradict, and the release gives explanations the 10-Q does not.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence. Inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory} rose from the recast year-end while revenue fell. Days sales of inventory rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, well above {trend_table.quarters-back-3.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} in the third quarter of 2025. The six-month inventory change of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.this_year_to_date} absorbed cash, and gross margin is the lowest filled quarter. No inventory reserve and no write-down is tagged in any period, and the MD&A gives no cause for the build. Possible reasons are the memory-chip availability the CFO names and inventory kept for the Amphenol agreement; a later write-down cannot be ruled out. Purchase commitments: none is tagged and no text is carried, so commitments beyond need cannot be assessed; nothing found, within that limit. Customer concentration. Comcast took {concentration.facts.38|pct} of second-quarter sales, against {concentration.facts.19|pct} a year earlier, and {concentration.facts.44|pct} of six-month sales, against {concentration.facts.17|pct}. Charter fell to {concentration.facts.45|pct} from {concentration.facts.21|pct}. Comcast and Charter hold {concentration.facts.41|pct} and {concentration.facts.47|pct} of receivables. Dependence on a single customer is high and rising, partly because the recast removed RUCKUS's broader customer base. Channel stuffing. The distributor TD Synnex left the concentration list with RUCKUS, Comcast's receivable share sits below its sales share, and deferred revenue grew on a like-for-like basis. Beyond the unexplained rise in days sales outstanding, nothing found. Circular or vendor-financed deals. No investment in a customer is disclosed, and the gains on unidentified financial assets cannot be classified. The continuing supply and service agreements with Amphenol, the buyer of CCS and OWN/DAS, keep revenue from the buyer in continuing operations while the company pays the buyer for reverse transition services. That two-way relationship is worth watching, but it is not vendor financing.
industry_lens.verdict: Customer concentration on Comcast is high and rising, and inventory is building into falling sales with no disclosed reserve. No vendor financing is visible, though the continuing agreements with the buyer of the divested businesses deserve watching.

reconciliation.why: Aurora net sales print close to consolidated net sales, and the largest customers are cable operators. The narrowed service-provider description fits the recast revenue.
Between the 10-K and the 10-Q, the year-end held-for-sale lines rose while goodwill, receivables and inventory fell. That is the pattern moving RUCKUS to held for sale produces.
Recast year-end receivables, inventory and cash are each lower than the 10-K printed for the same date, with totals unchanged. Prior-period continuing figures moved down, as the note says.
The year-end allowance the 10-Q prints differs from the 10-K's, and the first-quarter warranty input comes from the recast filing. The numbers hold no bridge either.

For the quarter and six months, the tagged facts print Comcast at {concentration.facts.38|pct} and {concentration.facts.44|pct} and Charter at {concentration.facts.45|pct} and {concentration.facts.48|pct}. Charter's prior-year shares print at {concentration.facts.21|pct} and {concentration.facts.20|pct}, matching the note.

The tagged facts print Comcast at {concentration.facts.41|pct} and Charter at {concentration.facts.47|pct} of receivables. At the first-quarter end they printed Comcast at {concentration.facts.36|pct} and TD Synnex at {concentration.facts.32|pct}. The allowance ratio {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} is the lowest filled quarter.

The release's six-month column prints no restricted cash at the quarter end. The restricted-cash figure in its three-month column equals the March-end amount the note gives, which fits a return in April. The defect is in the presentation, not in the return itself.
The numbers reader finds the same two period-end totals for one date in the release cash-flow statement, and no check that reconciles them.

The release prints the benefit on a pretax loss and the continuing income that results. The six-month tagged continuing tax line is a benefit of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.parts.this_year_to_date}.

The recast six-month continuing benefit, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.parts.this_year_to_date}, is smaller than the second quarter's benefit alone. So the recast first quarter no longer carries the tax-planning benefit in continuing operations.

Second-quarter net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter} stands far above continuing income, and deferred tax assets fell sharply, so the discontinued tax lines are large. The numbers show their size, not their cause.
Python has no valuation-allowance field and no continuing interest expense for fiscal 2025, so the numbers cannot show where the allowance went.
The distribution recorded exceeds the cash paid, which is consistent with dividend equivalents being recorded at declaration. But no number tests the participating-securities judgment.
The release prints the redemption of the convertible preferred within the six months, so none was outstanding in the second quarter.
No number bears on pending-standard disclosures.
The tagged proceeds confirm the sale, but no tagged figure carries transaction costs, taxes or an expected gain.
The 10-Q tags the RUCKUS proceeds as a subsequent event at the amount the note states. Removing the held-for-sale balances falls in the next quarter, which is not yet in the record.
No number in the inputs carries the OWN/DAS adjustment or its direction.
Python carries no discontinued-operations revenue field, so the negative MSA revenue cannot be checked.
Aurora net sales print close to consolidated net sales, so the revenue kept in corporate and other looks small. But no number isolates the Amphenol agreements.
Transition-service income printed far below the prior-year periods at the figures the note gives, so the net cost of these arrangements is rising. The next quarter is not yet in the record.

Debt at the quarter end is {terms.debt_now}, against {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} a year earlier. Receivables of {terms.balances_now.receivables} and inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory} make up the base the note describes.
No tagged figure carries revolver commitments.
Debt at the quarter end is {terms.debt_now}, consistent with no borrowings, and the release states the same availability the note gives.
Trailing interest expense cannot be computed because fiscal 2025 has no continuing interest-expense row.

Cash at the quarter end is {terms.balances_now.cash} after the distribution, which points to a smaller base. But the RUCKUS proceeds arrived the next day and the year-end cash outlook is higher, so next quarter's direction is open.
The release segment table prints only Aurora and corporate and other.
Corporate and other printed an operating loss outside Aurora; those are the costs that will move. The reallocation starts next quarter, which is not yet in the record.
The release prints Core adjusted EBITDA and Aurora operating income for both years on the Aurora-only definition.

The filing's own reconciliation table, as quoted, gives different six-month and prior-year-quarter figures from the prose. No tagged field carries the caption, so the contradiction rests on the table.
Quarterly revenue changed {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year on year on the recast basis.
Aurora net sales printed below the prior-year quarter.

The year-ago quarter's margin, {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, stands above every later quarter in the release's recast adjusted series. That fits a high-margin licence sale and supports the CFO; the MD&A's silence on it remains.
Gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} is the lowest filled quarter, so gross profit fell. The numbers cannot say whether input costs helped or hurt.
Accrued and other liabilities fell after the recast year-end, and the six-month payables-and-accruals change is an outflow. Both fit a lower accrual and higher payments.
No tagged figure carries legal expense.

Six-month research and development expense is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.this_year_to_date} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date}.
Tagged restructuring charges and the reserve both rose. The reserve is tagged to the earlier programme, which the prose does not explain.

The six-month pretax result of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income.parts.this_year_to_date} sits above the operating result of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_income.parts.this_year_to_date}, so non-operating items lifted income. The gains cannot be separated from interest.
Aurora operating income printed far below the prior-year quarter. The prose's conflicting statements on SG&A and volume cannot be tested, because no SG&A field exists.
The tagged dividend and the release cash-flow line both carry the figure the other passages give. The numbers contradict the MD&A sentence the item quotes.

Between the recast year-end and the quarter end, inventory ({terms.balances_now.inventory}) and prepaid assets rose and accrued liabilities fell. The six-month inventory change of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.this_year_to_date} absorbed cash.

Debt repaid, {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid}, is the largest movement, as the MD&A says. But the release also prints large outflows for the preferred redemption and the distribution, which the explanation leaves out.

Six-month operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.this_year_to_date} is worse than {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.prior_year_to_date}. Interest paid fell to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_paid.parts.this_year_to_date} from {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_paid.parts.prior_year_to_date}, matching the stated offset.

Six-month capital expenditure is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.this_year_to_date} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.prior_year_to_date}. The decrease the prose states is the current level, so the numbers contradict the sentence.

Fiscal 2025 repayments of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid.parts.prior_fiscal_year} equal the first-half repayments of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid.parts.prior_year_to_date}, but no tagged figure shows which notes the year-end total holds.
The distribution recorded exceeds the cash paid, consistent with a payable to award holders that is still to be settled in cash.
The 10-Q tags six-month common dividends at the total the note states.
Stock repurchased is tagged as nil for the six months.
The 10-Q tags the per-share declaration as a subsequent event.
Cash at the quarter end is {terms.balances_now.cash}, and the RUCKUS proceeds arrive after it. The year-end figure is a forecast the record cannot test.
Prepaid assets rose and deferred tax assets fell, but no tagged line identifies a tax receivable.
Gross margin is the lowest filled quarter, and the adjusted gross-profit share fell, the direction the risk statement describes.
Corporate and other carried an operating loss, but whether stranded costs will be cut is a forecast.
Python carries no earnings-per-share field, so the numbers cannot say which document is right.
Total inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory} is tagged, but no tagged figure separates the inventory retained from divested businesses.

anomalies.name: Operating cash flow covers almost none of net income
anomalies.what: Operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2025. Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}, and the annual accruals cell is the highest filled year. Divestiture gains and discontinued-operations income, with the proceeds in investing cash flow, explain the gap.

anomalies.name: Working-capital changes do not articulate
anomalies.what: The receivables gap is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap} and the inventory gap is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}. The balance sheet shows declines and the cash-flow statement shows cash absorbed. The year-earlier balances were filed before the divestitures, and the cash flows are not segregated, so the two sides cover different businesses. No text bridges them, and the payables change is not tagged.

anomalies.name: Operating cash outflow deepens
anomalies.what: Six-month operating cash flow is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.this_year_to_date}, against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.prior_year_to_date} a year earlier, and the derived quarter is {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}. This happened even though interest paid fell. The MD&A names working capital, incentive payments and cash taxes.

anomalies.name: Income far more volatile than cash
anomalies.what: Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, far above the neutral level. Income moves much more than cash because of disposal gains and discontinued tax items. This is the opposite of smoothing.

anomalies.name: Trailing figures mix recast and as-filed bases
anomalies.name_ko: 최근 네 분기 수치가 재작성 기준과 최초 공시 기준을 섞음
anomalies.what: The 10-K's fiscal 2025, which includes RUCKUS, is added to recast year-to-date figures. As a result, the year-earlier trailing revenue is {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.revenue}, trailing revenue growth is {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters}, and trailing gross margin {ratios.profitability.gross_margin|pct} carries the same mismatch. None of these describes the remaining business.

anomalies.name: Interest income earned on cash being paid out
anomalies.what: The MD&A ties interest income to CCS sale proceeds that funded the distribution, and quarter-end cash is {terms.balances_now.cash}. Non-operating items lifted the six-month pretax result, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income.parts.this_year_to_date}, above the operating result, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_income.parts.this_year_to_date}. That income rests on a balance that is being distributed.

anomalies.name: Days sales outstanding rise without explanation
anomalies.what: Days sales outstanding rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} while revenue fell, but the comparison cells are on mixed bases. No text explains the receivable balance. Comcast's share of receivables rose to {concentration.facts.41|pct}.

anomalies.name: Contract liabilities fall only against as-filed periods
anomalies.name_ko: 계약부채 감소는 최초 공시 기준과의 비교에서만 나타남
anomalies.what: The ratio fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}, but the earlier balance included RUCKUS. Against the recast year-end, the current balance of {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} is higher.

anomalies.name: Prior-year licence sales cited only in the release
anomalies.what: The CFO cites strong licence sales in the prior-year quarter; the MD&A is silent on them. That quarter's margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct} fits licence revenue recognised at a point in time, but the filing gives no detail.

anomalies.name: Negative MSA revenue in discontinued operations
anomalies.what: Amphenol MSA net revenue is negative for the quarter and the six months, and no credits, returns or price adjustments are named. No field carries it.

anomalies.name: Fourth-quarter cells rest on a different revenue tag
anomalies.name_ko: 넷째 분기 셀이 다른 매출 태그를 사용
anomalies.what: Fourth-quarter cells use a different revenue concept from the other quarters, so fourth-quarter revenue concentration cannot be tested.

anomalies.name: Bad-debt allowance at its thinnest
anomalies.what: The ratio of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} is the lowest filled quarter, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} a year earlier and {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} in fiscal 2022. Receivables are concentrated in two customers, and no text explains the thinning.

anomalies.name: Continuing income is a discrete tax benefit
anomalies.what: The six-month continuing tax line is a benefit of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.parts.this_year_to_date} on pretax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income.parts.this_year_to_date}. The note names an equity-compensation tax benefit and a remeasurement, and does not say either will recur.

anomalies.name: Unexplained discontinued-operations tax benefit
anomalies.what: Quarterly net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter} rests mostly on a RUCKUS tax benefit that no paragraph explains. It is a deferred-tax judgment, not cash.

anomalies.name: Tax-planning benefit left continuing operations
anomalies.what: The recast six-month continuing benefit is smaller than the second quarter's benefit alone, so the first-quarter tax-planning benefit has moved out of continuing operations. No text says where it now sits.

anomalies.name: Prior-year valuation allowance dropped from the explanation
anomalies.what: The recast prior-year tax explanation no longer mentions the additional valuation allowance. No field can trace it.

anomalies.name: Deferred tax assets drawn down sharply
anomalies.what: Deferred tax assets on the release balance sheet fell steeply from the recast year-end, and the cash-flow statement shows a large non-cash deferred-tax item. No note explains the movement.

anomalies.name: Incentive-compensation accrual lowered
anomalies.what: Incentive expense fell while payments rose and accrued liabilities declined. A lower accrual raises income. No field carries the amount, so no adjustment is written.

anomalies.name: Legal expense falls with no matter named
anomalies.what: Legal expense fell in the quarter and the six months. No matter, settlement or resolution is named.

anomalies.name: Gains on unidentified financial assets
anomalies.what: Other income gained on financial assets the notes do not identify. These gains cannot be separated from interest income.

anomalies.name: Goodwill unchanged while Aurora profit falls
anomalies.what: Goodwill is unchanged since the recast year-end, while Aurora operating income fell sharply and gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} is the lowest filled quarter. No impairment-test or headroom text is carried.

anomalies.name: Warranty ratio at a quarterly high
anomalies.what: The ratio of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio} is the highest filled quarter, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio} a year earlier. That is the conservative direction, and no text explains it.

anomalies.name: Restructuring charges and reserve rise
anomalies.what: Charges and the reserve rose under a new plan, but the reserve is tagged to the earlier programme's member.

anomalies.name: Disposal estimates adjusted or withdrawn without cause
anomalies.name_ko: 매각 관련 추정치의 설명 없는 조정·철회
anomalies.what: The OWN/DAS carrying value was adjusted, with no cause or direction given. The RUCKUS transaction-cost estimate was withdrawn, with no update.

anomalies.name: Soft-asset share at its high
anomalies.what: The share of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} is the highest filled quarter, against {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}. Most of the rise is cash paid out in the distribution, not capitalized cost.

anomalies.name: Prepaid and other current assets jump, contents unknown
anomalies.what: Prepaid expenses and other current assets rose steeply, with a large operating outflow on the line. The MD&A names the rise but not its contents. The restricted deposits were returned, so the rise is something else.

anomalies.name: Restructuring and transaction costs presented as one-off recur
anomalies.what: These charges appear in every period presented, and further actions are expected. The Core and non-GAAP measures exclude them.

anomalies.name: Core measure excludes stranded costs
anomalies.what: Core is now Aurora alone. Corporate costs once allocated to the divested businesses sit outside it while the offsetting transition-service income falls.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP close to GAAP only through the tax line
anomalies.name_ko: 세금 항목 때문에만 비GAAP과 GAAP이 비슷
anomalies.what: Adjusted net income sits close to GAAP continuing income because the GAAP figure includes the discrete tax benefit, which the reconciliation reverses. No gap field exists.

anomalies.name: Research and development cut
anomalies.what: Six-month R&D is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.this_year_to_date}, against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date}. Nothing is capitalized, so the cut lifts current earnings.

anomalies.name: Cash flows not segregated for discontinued operations
anomalies.what: Operating cash flow carries the sold businesses, cash taxes and interest of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_paid} on debt now at {terms.debt_now}, while the divestiture proceeds sit in investing. No field separates these items.

anomalies.name: Restricted-cash column does not tie
anomalies.what: The release's three-month column prints a restricted-cash line equal to the March-end amount, with a total that does not tie. The six-month column prints none. Nothing shows the returned deposits ran through operating cash flow.

anomalies.name: Cash dividend equivalents to award holders
anomalies.what: The distribution recorded exceeds the cash paid. Dividend equivalents on unvested awards will be paid in cash as the awards vest, without passing through the income statement. This comes on top of share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}.

anomalies.name: Prior-period values recast without a bridge
anomalies.name_ko: 연결 설명 없는 전기 수치 재작성
anomalies.what: Most year-end 10-K lines are superseded by different 10-Q values, while the totals are unchanged. The recast is disclosed, but no text bridges the filed balances to the recast ones.

anomalies.name: Deferred tax liability moves up on recast
anomalies.what: Every other superseded line moved down or into held for sale, but the deferred tax liability printed slightly higher. No text explains it.

anomalies.name: Identical share counts at two year-ends
anomalies.what: The 10-K tags the same shares outstanding at both year-ends while weighted shares differ, which points to a tagging carry-forward.

anomalies.name: Debt table carries notes the MD&A calls repurchased
anomalies.what: The year-end debt column lists notes that the MD&A says were repurchased in full in the first half of 2025.

anomalies.name: No control change reported amid transition
anomalies.what: The controls item reports no change, despite reverse transition services, the move to held for sale and the shift to a single segment.

anomalies.name: Disclosures removed or changed without comment
anomalies.what: Pending-standard disclosures were removed without comment, and the first-quarter treatment of preferred-share dilution changed with the recast.

anomalies.name: Transaction-cost prose disagrees with table
anomalies.what: For the six months and the prior-year quarter, the MD&A prose gives figures that differ from its own reconciliation table.

anomalies.name: Special distribution stated at two amounts
anomalies.what: One MD&A sentence gives a figure that neither the tagged dividend nor either cash-flow presentation carries.

anomalies.name: Capital-expenditure decrease misstated
anomalies.what: The prose states the decrease at the current level, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.this_year_to_date}, rather than as the fall from {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.prior_year_to_date}.

anomalies.name: Basic EPS differs between release and 10-Q
anomalies.what: Basic earnings per share, both from discontinued operations and in total, differ between the release and the note. No field says which is right.

anomalies.name: Release quarterly cash use differs from derived quarter
anomalies.what: Python's derived quarter, {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}, differs slightly from the release figure, which implies an unexplained recast of first-quarter cash flow.

anomalies.name: Input-cost explanations conflict
anomalies.what: The MD&A credits lower input costs, while the CFO names memory-chip pricing as a headwind. The fall in gross margin cannot be split between the two explanations.

anomalies.name: Aurora prose contradicts itself
anomalies.what: The Aurora paragraph names higher SG&A while the consolidated paragraph says SG&A fell, and it gives both lower and higher volume for the six months.

anomalies.name: Release cash total includes cash held for sale
anomalies.what: The release's cash total includes cash held for sale, while the balance sheet prints {terms.balances_now.cash}. The release states the difference.

anomalies.name: MD&A omits the revolver cut
anomalies.what: The MD&A still describes the revolver at its old size after the commitments were reduced.

anomalies.name: Explanations found only in the release
anomalies.what: The tax refund, the split between legacy and Access Technologies sales, and the year-end cash and acquisition plans appear only in the release.

anomalies.name: Capitalization explanation omits the distribution
anomalies.what: Debt repaid, {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid}, is the largest driver, but the explanation leaves out the preferred redemption and the distribution.

anomalies.name: Inventory builds into falling sales
anomalies.what: Inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory} rose, and days of inventory reached {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}. No reserve or write-down is tagged, and no cause is given.

anomalies.name: Comcast concentration rising
anomalies.what: Comcast's share of sales is {concentration.facts.38|pct}, against {concentration.facts.19|pct} a year earlier, and its share of receivables is {concentration.facts.41|pct}.

anomalies.name: Two-way agreements with the buyer of divested businesses
anomalies.what: Revenue from Amphenol stays in continuing operations, while the company pays Amphenol for reverse transition services. Its MSA revenue is negative.

adjustments.name: Remove the discrete continuing-operations tax benefit
adjustments.quote: the Company recognized an income tax benefit of $28.7 million on a pretax loss of $2.6 million

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 영업현금흐름은 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income|pct}에 불과합니다. 운전자본 때문이 아니라 사업 매각 차익과 중단영업 세금 항목이 순이익을 키웠기 때문이며, 올해 상반기 영업현금흐름은 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.this_year_to_date}로 전년 동기 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.prior_year_to_date}보다 나빠졌습니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 이번 분기 매출채권 회수일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 직전 분기보다 늘었지만, 직전 분기 수치에는 RUCKUS가 포함되어 있어 같은 기준의 비교가 아닙니다. 계약부채는 재작성 기준으로 오히려 늘어, 매출을 앞당겨 인식한 흔적은 보이지 않습니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 이번 분기 계속영업이익은 세전 손실에 붙은 일회성 법인세 혜택에서 나왔고, 대손충당금 비율 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}은 기록상 가장 낮습니다. 상반기 계속영업 법인세 혜택 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.parts.this_year_to_date}은 반복되지 않는 항목으로 보고 이익에서 뺐습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 개발비 자본화는 없고, 연성자산 비중 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}의 상승은 주로 특별배당으로 현금이 빠져나간 결과입니다. 다만 선급비용 급증의 내용은 공개되지 않았고, 구조조정·거래 비용은 매 기간 반복되는데도 회사의 핵심 지표에서 제외됩니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망 금융으로 영업현금흐름을 끌어올린 흔적은 없습니다. 오히려 매각된 사업의 세금과 이자 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_paid}가 영업현금흐름을 낮췄고, 구매약정·보증 같은 부외 항목은 태그가 없어 측정할 수 없습니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 감사인 교체나 내부통제의 중대한 취약점은 보이지 않지만, 같은 날 제출된 임원 변경 공시의 본문은 확인할 수 없었습니다. 전기 재무상태표 수치가 RUCKUS 재분류로 크게 바뀌었으나 이는 공시된 재작성이며, 총자산은 그대로입니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 보도자료와 10-Q의 핵심 수치는 일치하지만, MD&A의 거래비용, 특별배당 금액, 설비투자 감소액 문장은 회사 자신의 표나 태그된 수치와 맞지 않습니다. 라이선스 매출, 메모리칩 가격, 세금 환급에 대한 설명은 보도자료에만 있습니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: Comcast 비중이 이번 분기 매출의 {concentration.facts.38|pct}로 전년 동기 {concentration.facts.19|pct}보다 높아졌고, 매출이 줄어드는 가운데 재고가 {terms.balances_now.inventory}로 늘었지만 재고충당금은 공시되지 않았습니다. 고객사 투자를 통한 순환 거래는 보이지 않으나, 매각 사업 인수자인 Amphenol과의 계약은 지켜볼 필요가 있습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
